title: Understanding the organization and its privacy context
objective: The organization shall determine external and internal issues, legal mandates, and interested party expectations relevant to its Privacy Information Management System (PIMS) as a standalone management system.
transition_note: ISO/IEC 27701:2025 standalone clause 4 replaces 2019 extension clause.

title: PIMS Leadership and commitment
objective: Top management shall demonstrate leadership with respect to the privacy management system, establishing the formal corporate PIMS policy and privacy objectives.
transition_note: Direct management commitment requirement under 2025 edition.

title: Privacy Risk Assessment & Treatment
objective: The organization shall apply a dedicated privacy risk assessment process considering impacts on PII principals (data subjects), independent of corporate asset risks.
transition_note: Standalone privacy risk assessment methodology mandated in 2025 edition.

title: Conditions for collection and processing
objective: The organization shall determine, document, and publish lawful bases for processing PII, including freely given, specific, and informed consent.
transition_note: Aligned with GDPR Art. 6/7 & India DPDP Act 2023 Sec. 6.

title: Privacy Notice & Transparency
objective: Clear, accessible, and concise privacy notices shall be provided to PII principals at or before the time of PII collection.
transition_note: Mandates multi-lingual notices under DPDP Act & EU transparency directives.

title: Obligations to PII Principals (DSAR Rights)
objective: The organization shall provide automated and verified mechanisms for PII principals to exercise their rights of access, correction, erasure, and data portability within statutory timelines (30 days GDPR / 72h critical).
transition_note: Includes SLA timer tracking and audit trail of principal verification.

title: Privacy by Design and Default
objective: Systems and processes shall embed data minimization, pseudonymization, and purpose limitation into the engineering lifecycle by default.
transition_note: Technical enforcement in database schemas and API payloads.

title: Cross-Border PII Transfer Accountability
objective: The organization shall verify adequacy decisions, Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), or local regulatory authorizations before initiating international PII transfers.
transition_note: Reflects updated cross-border transfer requirements under DPDP Act 2023 & Schrems II.

title: Subprocessor Management & Notification
objective: Processors shall not engage sub-processors without prior written authorization from the customer/controller and shall enforce equivalent privacy terms.
transition_note: Subprocessor registry and 30-day change objection window.

title: Breach Notification to Controllers
objective: Processors shall notify controllers without undue delay (within 24-48 hours) upon confirming a security incident affecting customer PII.
transition_note: Critical contractual SLA requirement for B2B SaaS platforms.
